translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content: Niandi simbidi nza mu mioko miandi.

content.text: Yizanu, bika tuyimbidila Yave mu khini.
Bika tuyamikina kuidi ditadi di phulusu eto.
Bika tuizanu ku ntualꞌandi mu vana matondo
tunyayisa mu miziki ayi mu minkunga.
Bila Yave widi Nzambi yinneni,
ntinu wunneni va yilu zinzambi zioso.
Va koko kuandi muidi vadi phinda zi ntoto
zitsongi zi miongo zivuiwulu kuidi niandi.
Mbu wandi bila niandi veka wuvanga wawu
ayi mioko miandi mivanga ntoto wu yuma.
Yizanu bika tukikulula mu buongama,
bika tufukamanu va ntuala Yave mvangi eto.
Bila niandi Nzambi eto
ayi beto tuidi batu bandi keta dikila,
nkangu mamemi mu ku tsi lukebolo luandi.
Enati lumbu kiaku luwilu mbembo andi,
lubika kitula mintima mieno ngolo
banga bu luvangila Meliba,
banga bu luvangila mu lumbu ki Masa mu dikanga ;
Kuna madise beno bathotila ayi batsokila ;
ka diambu ko bamona momo ndivanga.
Mu makumaya ma mimvu, ndiba mu nganzi
kuidi tsungi yina ; ndituba :
“badi batu badi mintima mizimbila
ayi basia zaba zinzila ziama ko.”
Diawu ndizengila ndefi ku tsi nganzi ama :
“balendi kota ko mu luvundulu luama.”
